zh: 如果能造 k 辆车，那么换成最短的 k 辆一定也能造：把选中的长车换成没选的短车，任何一条线都不会超时。
所以把时长升序排列，逐个尝试前缀能否造完；判断一组车能否分到两条线上，就是看是否存在分给第一条线的总时长 s 满足 s≤X 且总时长−s≤Y，这是一个子集和问题。
用位集合记录第一条线可能达到的总时长（只保留 0..X 位），初始只有 0。依次加入第 i 短的车：总时长累加，若超过 X+Y 就停止；位集合与其左移该时长后的结果取并，再截到 X；若存在不小于 总时长−Y 的可达位，答案更新为 i+1，否则停止。
en: If some k cars can be built, the k shortest cars can be built too: swapping a chosen long car for an unchosen short one never pushes either line over its budget.

So sort the durations ascending and test prefixes one at a time. A group of cars fits on the two lines when some total s assigned to line 1 satisfies s≤X and total−s≤Y, which is a subset-sum question.

Keep a bitset of the totals line 1 can reach, limited to bits 0..X, starting with only 0. Add the i-th shortest car: increase the running total and stop if it exceeds X+Y; OR the bitset with itself shifted left by the duration and cut it back to X; if some reachable bit is at least total−Y, set the answer to i+1, otherwise stop.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Try adding prefixes in ascending order of duration, and use a bitset to maintain the reachable total durations on the first line for this group of cars. The prefix can be built if there is a total s≤X with total sum−s≤Y.

## Proof of correctness

Whenever some k cars are feasible, swapping a selected longer car for an unselected shorter one never makes either line exceed its budget, so the k shortest cars are feasible too. The bitset exactly enumerates the subset sums of every assignment of each car to the first or second line; the longest feasible prefix is the optimal number of cars.

## Complexity

Time O(N log N+NX/w), bitset space O(X/w), plus O(N) to store the input, where w is the machine word width.
